## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; confirmed by weak overall sector breadth (≤4/11) and both Financials (1W: -1.93%) and Industrials (1W: -2.76%) negative; defensives are not clearly leading.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads on a 1W basis: XOM RECOVERY (1W: +0.35% | 1M: -10.42%), CVX RECOVERY (1W: +0.83% | 1M: -11.07%). Technology showing pockets of strength: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +29.36% | 1M: +92.72%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +26.49%). Utilities showing mild strength: CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.60% | 1M: +6.77%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Communication weakest: CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -28.64% | 1M: -20.09%). Consumer Discretionary soft: TSLA CORRECTION (1W: -3.52% | 1M: +1.76%). Healthcare under pressure: JNJ BELOW TREND (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -5.81%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +29.36% | 1M: +92.72%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +21.71% | 1M: +64.22%), TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.32% | 1M: +39.34%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.65% | 1M: +32.32%), CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.60% | 1M: +6.77%). Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology) — narrow pockets of outperformance.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: SHOP CORRECTION (1W: -8.07% | 1M: +7.62%), RCL BELOW TREND (1W: -8.29% | 1M: -5.52%), ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -9.27% | 1M: -9.14%), NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -9.30% | 1M: -12.73%), IBM BELOW TREND (1W: -10.11% | 1M: -5.64%). Weakness concentrated in high-multiple tech and select industrial names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
1W momentum leaders: INTC (1W: +29.36%), AMD (1W: +21.71%), TXN (1W: +15.32%), UNH (1W: +9.65%), QCOM (1W: +9.26%) — all ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present: multiple large caps (AAPL, JPM, TSLA, MA, V) show 1W vs 1M mismatch → MAJOR divergence, watch for trend breaks and avoid broad regime extrapolation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is mixed but with strong winners; MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +16.08%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +26.49%), AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -1.99% | 1M: +5.82%). Sector breadth: Technology positive on 1W (24 stocks) but leadership narrow — pockets of momentum amid broader caution.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials soft on 1W with internal dispersion; JPM CORRECTION (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +7.39%), V CORRECTION (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +1.35%), MA CORRECTION (1W: -1.98% | 1M: +1.31%). Sector breadth: Financials negative on 1W (20 stocks) — contributes to the RISK-OFF confirmation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare showing downside pressure overall but UNH is an outlier; UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.65% | 1M: +32.32%), JNJ BELOW TREND (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -5.81%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -5.61% | 1M: -3.20%). Sector breadth: Healthcare negative on 1W (17 stocks) — defensive rotation is not dominant.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
In a RISK-OFF backdrop favor quality, defensive pockets and reduce exposure to high-beta/momentum names that show short-term exhaustion (SHOP, CHTR, NOW). Favor holdings with confirmed above-trend profiles (UNH, NVDA, MSFT) while monitoring the major divergence across large caps.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +29.36% | 1M: +92.72%) — momentum continuation; AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +21.71% | 1M: +64.22%). BEARISH: CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -28.64% | 1M: -20.09%) — downside risk; LMT BELOW TREND (1W: -11.69% | 1M: -18.17%) — watch for follow-through.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy and pockets of Technology (Energy 1W: +3.75%, Tech 1W: +1.99%) for tactical opportunities. BEARISH: Communication and Consumer Discretionary (Comm 1W: -5.65%, ConsDisc 1W: -3.28%) as potential sources of further downside.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA: watch weekly follow-through above recent breakout or failure with a weekly close below last week’s low (ABOVE TREND pivot). AAPL: loss of the 1M up-pivot would reinforce CORRECTION risk. JPM: reclaiming the 1M trend would reduce Risk-Off signal; failure to hold weekly support increases pressure.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
DLR (+75): Real Estate headline — price context shows sector-level mixed action; treat as CORRECTION-like (sector 1W: -2.48% | 1M: +8.50%) — sentiment is constructive but watch follow-through. PLD (+80): Real Estate upbeat; sector divergence suggests news may predate price catch-up (approx. 1W: -2.48% | 1M: +8.50%). NEE (+55): Utilities beat — NEE likely confirming with sector strength (Utilities 1W: +1.68% | 1M: +1.91%) and may show accumulation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
TSLA (-80): Consumer Disc headline; TSLA CORRECTION (1W: -3.52% | 1M: +1.76%) — news confirms headline risk and stock weakness. META (-45): Technology headline; META ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +23.94%) — news is divergent versus price, monitor for distribution. ADBE (-50): Tech downgrade — watch for follow-through in tech momentum names (ADBE likely under pressure vs peer strength).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, style: Growth pockets (not broad) as technology shows concentrated leadership while overall breadth is weak. UNH ABOVE TREND, INTC ABOVE TREND and NVDA ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence across large caps (multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches) and negative sector breadth — monitor news-confirmation for allocation shifts.
